findings.claim: The component relies on a hook to determine dark mode instead of having dark mode set globally through stylesheets, which is inconsistent with how dark mode should ideally be handled.
The component applies custom styling on top of standard components instead of using only the available variants and sizes, which undermines design system consistency.

column.className is only applied to header cells while body cells are hand-rendered, forcing every caller to re-implement column layout instead of the table owning structural styling for both header and body via per-column cell renderers.
The same header/body styling duplication issue recurs here and should instead be handled by a renderRow implementation in the Table component.
